# Public API — lirantal.com

All endpoints are public, read-only GET resources and require no authentication.

- `GET https://lirantal.com/api/posts.json` returns all published post metadata, newest first.
- `GET https://lirantal.com/api/posts/cursor/0.json` returns the first page of up to 50 records.
- Continue at `/api/posts/cursor/{cursor}.json` using `nextCursor` until it is `null`.
- `GET https://lirantal.com/openapi.json` describes the API in OpenAPI 3.1.
- `GET https://lirantal.com/health.json` returns a static liveness response.
- `GET https://lirantal.com/rss.xml` returns the RSS feed.

The API does not provide server-side search, authentication, write operations, or a dedicated remote MCP server. Filter metadata locally and fetch an article's `markdownUrl` for its full text. See the [developer portal](https://lirantal.com/developers).
